appeal_ban.subject: Requesting review of my ban
appeal_ban.body: My account was banned and I honestly don't understand why. I've had this account for years and never thought I was breaking any rules. Could someone please take a second look at this? I'm happy to explain anything that was flagged.

appeal_ban.subject: Ban appeal - think this was a mistake
appeal_ban.body: I got an email saying my account was banned for policy violations but it didn't say which post or action caused it. I've gone back through my activity and can't find anything that should have triggered this. Please review and let me know what happened.

appeal_ban.subject: Please reconsider the ban on my account
appeal_ban.body: I understand you have rules to enforce, but I think whatever triggered this ban was a misunderstanding. I run a small business through this account and losing it is a real problem for me. Can you tell me specifically what happened so I can address it?

appeal_ban.subject: Account banned, need this reversed
appeal_ban.body: This account has never been reported before as far as I know. I was banned suddenly with no warning. If this is about a comment I made in an argument last week, I'll admit it got heated but I don't think it crossed a line worth a permanent ban.

appeal_ban.subject: Appealing my ban - shared device issue
appeal_ban.body: I think my account got banned because of something that happened on a shared family device. My younger sibling also uses this phone and I suspect they may have been on my account without me knowing. Is there any way to review the specific activity that led to this?

appeal_ban.subject: Wrongful ban appeal
appeal_ban.body: I was banned right after reporting someone else for harassment, which feels like a coincidence I want flagged. I didn't do anything against the rules myself. Please look into both the report I filed and the ban on my account.

appeal_suspension.subject: Suspension appeal - didn't realize this would happen
appeal_suspension.body: I got a suspension notice and I want to understand exactly what I did wrong. I've read through the community guidelines again and I'm still not sure which rule applies to what I posted. Could you point me to the specific post or comment?

appeal_suspension.subject: Requesting early review of suspension
appeal_suspension.body: I'm currently suspended and I get that the platform needed to act on something, but I think the length of this suspension is harsh for what actually happened. Is there a process to have the duration reconsidered?

appeal_suspension.subject: Suspension seems tied to a report I disagree with
appeal_suspension.body: I believe this suspension came from a report filed by someone I had a disagreement with in the comments. I didn't use any language that should count as harassment. Can you review the actual content that was reported?

appeal_suspension.subject: Confused about why I'm suspended
appeal_suspension.body: I woke up to a suspension notice with no other context. I run a small storefront on here and this is affecting orders I already have in progress. Please help me understand what happened so I can avoid it going forward.

appeal_suspension.subject: First-time suspension, asking for leniency
appeal_suspension.body: This is the first time anything like this has happened to my account in three years of using the platform. I take the rules seriously and would appreciate a chance to explain my side before the suspension runs its full course.

appeal_suspension.subject: Suspension appeal with additional context
appeal_suspension.body: I want to give some context that I don't think was considered before this suspension was applied. The post in question was quoting someone else's message to report it, not endorsing it. Please re-review with that in mind.

appeal_warning_strike.subject: Appealing a strike on my account
appeal_warning_strike.body: I received a strike notice and I'm not clear on what specifically triggered it. My account has been in good standing until now and I'd like to understand the reasoning before it affects anything else.

appeal_warning_strike.subject: Warning appeal - post was satire
appeal_warning_strike.body: The comment that got flagged was clearly meant as a joke between friends who follow each other, not a genuine statement. I understand it can read differently out of context, but I'd like this warning reconsidered.

appeal_warning_strike.subject: Strike feels excessive for a first offense
appeal_warning_strike.body: I got a strike for something I now realize probably did cross a line, but this is genuinely the first time I've had any issue on this account. Is there room to have it downgraded to a warning instead?

appeal_warning_strike.subject: Disputing a warning on a deleted comment
appeal_warning_strike.body: I deleted the comment in question myself as soon as I realized it might be an issue, before I even got the warning. I'd like that to be taken into account when reviewing this.

appeal_warning_strike.subject: Warning was issued to the wrong account I think
appeal_warning_strike.body: I got a warning referencing a comment I don't remember writing and can't find in my history. Is it possible this was misattributed? I'd appreciate a second look at the specific content in question.

appeal_warning_strike.subject: Appealing a strike tied to a group discussion
appeal_warning_strike.body: The strike references a comment I made in what I thought was a private-feeling thread with people I know well. I understand the platform is public, but the tone was clearly among friends, not a public attack on anyone.

appeal_content_removal.subject: My post was removed and I don't understand why
appeal_content_removal.body: One of my posts got taken down with a generic policy notice. I've looked at it again and I genuinely can't figure out what part violated the rules. Could you tell me specifically what triggered the removal?

appeal_content_removal.subject: Removed comment appeal
appeal_content_removal.body: A comment I left on someone else's post was removed. I was responding to a question they asked and don't think there was anything wrong with what I wrote. Please reconsider.

appeal_content_removal.subject: Story removed without explanation
appeal_content_removal.body: My story from yesterday was taken down and I never got a clear reason. It was just a photo from an event I attended with a caption. I'd like to understand what happened.

appeal_content_removal.subject: Message removed in a conversation - unclear why
appeal_content_removal.body: One of my messages in a conversation with a friend was flagged and removed. We were just talking about something that happened at work, nothing that should have triggered moderation as far as I can tell.

appeal_content_removal.subject: Content removal appeal - context matters here
appeal_content_removal.body: I think the post that was removed was misread out of context. It was actually me quoting a news article to talk about it, not making the statement myself. Please take another look with that context.

appeal_content_removal.subject: Appealing removal of an old post that suddenly got flagged
appeal_content_removal.body: This post has been up for over a year and was just removed now. Nothing about it changed on my end. Did something about the policy change, or was this a mistake?

account_access.subject: Can't reset my password
account_access.body: I've tried the password reset link three times now and the email never arrives, even after checking spam. My account email should still be active. Can you help me get back in another way?

account_access.subject: Lost access to my two-factor device
account_access.body: I set up two-factor authentication a while back and recently lost the phone with the authenticator app on it. I can't get past the login screen now. Is there a way to verify my identity another way and get 2FA reset?

account_access.subject: Email address on my account is outdated
account_access.body: The email tied to my account belongs to an old job I no longer have access to, so I can't receive verification codes or reset links. I can still log in on a device that's already signed in though - can you help me update it from here?

account_access.subject: Account locked after too many login attempts
account_access.body: My account got locked after I mistyped my password a few times trying to log in on a new phone. It's been locked for over a day now with no email telling me how to unlock it. What do I need to do?

account_access.subject: Can't verify my phone number
account_access.body: I'm trying to add a phone number for account recovery but the verification code never seems to arrive, even after multiple attempts and trying a different number. Is this a known issue?

account_access.subject: Signed in on the wrong account by mistake
account_access.body: I think I accidentally created a second account with a similar username to my real one and now I'm not sure which one my usual login goes to. Can you help me sort out which account is which?

account_access.subject: Login works on the app but not on the website
account_access.body: I can log in fine from my phone but the same credentials get rejected on the website with an error that doesn't explain anything. I've tried clearing cookies and a different browser already.

account_access.subject: Need to change the email on a account I can still access
account_access.body: I still have an active session on my laptop but I'd like to change the email address on file before it expires, since I no longer use the old inbox. What's the process for that?

account_data.subject: Requesting a copy of my data
account_data.body: I'd like to know what information the platform holds about me and, if possible, get a copy of it. Is there a process for requesting a data export?

account_data.subject: Question about how long you keep deleted content
account_data.body: I deleted a few old posts a while back and I'm curious whether that content is actually gone or still stored somewhere. Could you explain your retention practices?

account_data.subject: Asking what happens to my data if I deactivate
account_data.body: I'm considering deactivating my account for a while and want to understand what happens to my posts, messages, and profile information during that time before I do it.

account_data.subject: Wondering why my old username is still unavailable
account_data.body: I changed my username a long time ago and recently tried to give the old one to a friend, but it's still marked as taken. Is there a reason old usernames stay reserved?

account_data.subject: Question about who can see my activity history
account_data.body: I want to understand exactly what parts of my account activity are visible to other users versus only visible to staff for moderation purposes. Could you clarify the boundaries there?

account_data.subject: Asking about data shared with third parties
account_data.body: I saw a mention of analytics and recommendation systems in your terms and I'd like more detail on what account data feeds into those and whether I can opt out of any of it.

bug_report.subject: Comments not loading on some posts
bug_report.body: On a handful of posts in my feed, the comment section just spins and never loads any comments, even though I can see the comment count is nonzero. Refreshing the page doesn't help. Happens on both the app and the website for me.

bug_report.subject: Story views count seems wrong
bug_report.body: My story said it had been viewed by 12 people, but when I tapped to see who, only 4 names showed up. This has happened on a few different stories now, not just one.

bug_report.subject: Can't upload a video to a post
bug_report.body: Every time I try to add a video to a new post, the upload bar gets to about 90% and then just fails with a generic error. I've tried two different video files and both did the same thing.

bug_report.subject: Notifications arriving hours late
bug_report.body: I'm getting push notifications for likes and comments, but they seem to be arriving hours after the actual activity happened rather than close to real time. Wondering if this is a known delay or a bug on my end.

bug_report.subject: Direct message shows as unread even after opening it
bug_report.body: One specific conversation in my messages keeps showing an unread badge even though I've opened it and read every message inside. Other conversations mark as read normally.

bug_report.subject: Hashtag search returning nothing for a hashtag I know exists
bug_report.body: Searching for a hashtag that I've used myself and seen other people use is returning zero results for me right now. It was working a few days ago. Not sure if this is temporary.

bug_report.subject: Profile picture reverting to old photo
bug_report.body: I've updated my profile picture twice this week and both times it reverts back to an old photo after a day or so. The upload appears to succeed at the time I do it.

bug_report.subject: App crashes when opening the explore tab
bug_report.body: The app consistently crashes for me whenever I tap into the explore or discover tab. It happens every single time, right as the page starts loading content.

bug_report.subject: Post edit history not showing my most recent edit
bug_report.body: I edited a caption on one of my posts and the edit history shows the original version and one older edit, but not the most recent change I actually made.

bug_report.subject: Follower count not updating after new followers
bug_report.body: I've gained a few new followers this week that I can see individually in my followers list, but the total follower count on my profile hasn't moved at all.

safety_concern.subject: Someone is impersonating me off-platform
safety_concern.body: I've found an account on another site using my photos and a name close to mine, and they've been messaging people claiming to be me. I don't think this is something a normal content report covers since it's not on your platform, but I wanted to flag it in case it starts affecting my account here too.

safety_concern.subject: Concerned about a pattern of messages, not a single one
safety_concern.body: I'm not trying to report one specific message, but I've noticed a pattern of increasingly concerning messages from the same account over the past couple of weeks. I wanted to raise this as a broader safety concern rather than a single content report.

safety_concern.subject: Worried about a minor's account behavior
safety_concern.body: I believe I've come across an account that may belong to someone underage based on details they've shared, and some of the interactions I've seen around that account concern me. I wanted to raise this rather than just reporting individual posts.

safety_concern.subject: Someone found and shared my real location
safety_concern.body: A person I had a disagreement with online has started posting details that suggest they've figured out roughly where I live, including a comment referencing my neighborhood. This feels like more than something a single content report addresses.

safety_concern.subject: Coordinated harassment across multiple accounts
safety_concern.body: I'm being targeted by what looks like several accounts working together to comment negatively on everything I post, right after I post it. Individually the comments might not break rules, but the pattern feels coordinated and I wanted to flag it as a broader concern.

safety_concern.subject: Safety concern about content targeting a public event I'm attending
safety_concern.body: I've seen posts referencing a public event I'm scheduled to attend in a way that feels like it's encouraging people to show up and cause a disruption. I wanted to raise this ahead of time rather than after something happens.

other.subject: Question about upcoming feature availability
other.body: I noticed a feature mentioned in a changelog post that doesn't seem to be available on my account yet. Is this something that rolls out gradually, or should I be seeing it already?

other.subject: Feedback on the new profile layout
other.body: This isn't a bug report exactly, just feedback that the new profile layout makes it harder to find the saved posts tab than it used to be. Wanted to pass that along.

other.subject: Asking about verified badge criteria
other.body: I'm curious what the actual criteria are for getting a verified badge beyond what's listed publicly. Is there a minimum follower count or anything like that?

other.subject: General question about community guidelines updates
other.body: I noticed the community guidelines page mentions a recent update but doesn't show what specifically changed. Is there a changelog for the guidelines themselves?

other.subject: Question not covered by the other categories
other.body: I wasn't sure which category best fit this, but I wanted to ask whether there are plans to support scheduling posts in advance. Couldn't find anything about it in the help pages.

other.subject: Thank you note and a small suggestion
other.body: Not really a problem, just wanted to say the recent redesign of the messaging tab has been genuinely nice to use. One small suggestion: it would help to see typing indicators in group-style conversations.
